FirearmsEcommerce.PluginDescription: Ecommerce reports for gun and ammo shops: sales by caliber, brand and product type, and the cost per round of ammunition.
FirearmsEcommerce.SubcategoryHelp1: These reports group your Ecommerce orders by what the products are: firearms, ammunition or other products, their brand and their caliber. The plugin reads this from the product name or SKU when it builds the reports. It sends nothing anywhere.
FirearmsEcommerce.SubcategoryHelp2: Only orders are counted, not abandoned carts. Product page views are shown if your shop tracks them with setEcommerceView. Choose the product field to read in the website settings (Administration > Websites > Manage).
FirearmsEcommerce.ReportProductTypesDocumentation: Sales of firearms, ammunition and other products (accessories, optics, parts). The type is read from the product name or SKU and, if the setting is on, from the product categories.
FirearmsEcommerce.ReportBrandsDocumentation: Sales by brand. The brand is taken from the firearm model when the parser knows it, otherwise from a list of 126 firearm, ammunition, optics and accessory brands. Products of other brands are grouped as Unknown.
FirearmsEcommerce.ReportFirearmCalibersDocumentation: Firearm sales by caliber or gauge. The first caliber in the product name is used. Firearms whose name has no caliber are grouped as Unknown.
FirearmsEcommerce.ReportAmmoCalibersDocumentation: Ammunition sales by caliber or gauge, with the number of rounds sold and the average cost per round. Rounds are counted for products whose name gives the round count, such as "50 Rounds", "20rd" or "Box of 25".
FirearmsEcommerce.ReportAmmoCostPerRoundDocumentation: Ammunition products sold whose round count is known, with the rounds per box and the cost per round paid by your customers.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnProductViewsDocumentation: Product page views of these products, tracked with setEcommerceView.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnRevenueDocumentation: Revenue from these products: price times quantity. Excludes tax, shipping and discounts.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnOrdersDocumentation: Number of orders that contain at least one of these products.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnAveragePriceDocumentation: Average price paid per unit: revenue divided by quantity.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnRoundsDocumentation: Rounds sold: rounds per box times quantity, for products whose round count is known.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnRoundsRevenueDocumentation: Revenue from the products whose round count is known. The cost per round is this revenue divided by the rounds sold.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnCostPerRoundDocumentation: Average price paid per round: revenue of the products whose round count is known divided by the rounds sold.
FirearmsEcommerce.ColumnRoundsPerBoxDocumentation: Rounds in one unit of the product, read from its name.
FirearmsEcommerce.SettingProductFieldHelp: The Firearms & Ammo reports read the caliber, brand and type of each product from this field. Changes apply to reports archived after the change. To rebuild older reports, invalidate them (console core:invalidate-report-data).
FirearmsEcommerce.SettingProductFieldInvalid: Choose the product name, the SKU, or both.
FirearmsEcommerce.SettingUseCategories: Use product categories to tell firearms, ammunition and accessories apart
FirearmsEcommerce.SettingUseCategoriesHelp: When the first two categories of a product contain words such as Ammunition, Handguns, Optics or Magazines, they decide the product type. Turn this off if your categories do not describe the product type.
